method: Replayed build.rs hash_source over Git blobs: ordered roots src, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs, .cargo; recursively sorted immediate child paths; .DS_Store skipped; UTF-8 path byte length, path bytes, content byte length and content bytes hashed, lengths encoded as little-endian u64.

delta.equivalence: The 1024-byte buffer divides exactly into 256 four-byte chunks. Both forms yield the same chunks in the same order; f32 little-endian encoding and hashed byte range are unchanged.

scope: Source identity and exact source delta only. No binaries or checkpoint hashed; no builds, tests, benchmarks, execution equivalence or fresh performance claim.
